result.summary: Found 3 issues on this food delivery app screen, primarily related to loading states and content truncation.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in the 'Popular right now' section shows a loading spinner over the image, indicating the image has not finished loading or is stuck in a loading state.
issues.suggestion: Ensure images load properly with appropriate timeout handling and a fallback placeholder if loading fails.

issues.description: Restaurant names in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal list are truncated (e.g., 'Trattoria Piccol') due to the card extending beyond the viewport edge.
issues.suggestion: Consider adding ellipsis truncation with clear cutoff, or adjust card spacing so partial cards indicate scrollability without cutting text mid-word.

issues.description: The category filter row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', 'Burgers', 'Healthy') appears cut off at the right edge, suggesting more categories exist but the scroll affordance is not clearly indicated.
issues.suggestion: Add a visual indicator (fade or partial chip) to signal horizontal scrollability for the category filters.
